item.title: Lessons Every New Business Owner Learns in Their First Year of Business
item.description: Running a business is hard. Not the romantic, Instagram-caption kind of hard, but the everyday, slightly exhausting kind where there are a gazillion things happening at the same time. Customers need placating, bills need paying, employees need direction, and things just seem to pile up every once in a while. item.title: CBD refurbishment steams ahead
item.description: Greymouth heritage building, the former Nancarrow offices and latterly Steamers carvery, is taking on a new look and purpose as its conversion into upmarket apartments nears completion. The post CBD refurbishment steams ahead appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Tindale Cup back in Coast hands
item.description: West Coast have claimed the Tindale Cup for the first time in 16 years, with a composed and determined performance against Buller that finally brought the historic trophy back to the Coast for just the fourth time in its 35-year history. PICTURE: Bill Phillips, DiGiSPORT The post Tindale Cup back in Coast hands appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Church moves with the times
item.description: St Luke’s Anglican Church, which has quietly stood above the main road at Ngahere since the early 1950s, is on its way to a new life in a new town. The post Church moves with the times appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Harbinger of summer
item.description: Cicadas have emerged in force across the West Coast over the past week, bringing the familiar summer song, and this year especially they are making themselves heard. PICTURE: Supplied The post Harbinger of summer appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: SPCA prepares for ‘Caturdays’
item.description: SPCA Greymouth animal care attendant Jess Silbey at the centre this morning where there are currently seven kittens ready for adoption and more that will be ready in the coming days. The post SPCA prepares for ‘Caturdays’ appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: $5 million comes to the Coast
item.description: A Greymouth Lotto player had a Valentines Day to remember after waking up yesterday $5.08 million richer, sharing the $15 million Powerball jackpot. The post $5 million comes to the Coast appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Coast booked out for Year of the Horse
item.description: Chinese New Year has delivered a second wave of summer tourism to the West Coast, with accommodation booked out, rental cars snapped up and tour buses rolling. The post Coast booked out for Year of the Horse appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: New kiwi chick welcomed to Paparoa
item.description: Cousins Harlow O’Connor, of Moonlight, and Stella Loveridge, of Ngahere, were captivated looking at the new kiwi chick Mawhero during an open day with the Paparoa Wildlife Trust at the Atarau Kiwi Sanctuary on Saturday PICTURE: Lynne Berry The post New kiwi chick welcomed to Paparoa appeared first on Greymouth Star.
